import os

def T(x, y, s, size, color, weight="normal", anchor="start", spacing=None, family=None):

    fw = f' font-weight="{weight}"' if weight else ""
    fam = family or FONT
    return (f'<text x="{x}" y="{y}" font-family="{fam}" font-size="{size}"{fw}{ls} '
            f'fill="{color}" text-anchor="{anchor}">{esc(s)}</text>')

def defs():
    return (
        '<defs>'
        f'<linearGradient id="bar" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0"><stop offset="0" stop-color="{VIOLET}"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="{CYAN}"/></linearGradient>'
        f'<linearGradient id="barV" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="{VIOLET}"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="{CYAN}"/></linearGradient>'
        f'<linearGradient id="glass" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="{PANEL2}"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="{PANEL}"/></linearGradient>'
        '</defs>'

def svg(w, h, body):
    return (f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="{w}" height="{h}" viewBox="0 0 {w} {h}">'
            f'{defs()}<rect x="0" y="0" width="{w}" height="{h}" fill="{BG}"/>{body}</svg>')

def blobs(w, h):
    return (f'<circle cx="{w*0.88}" cy="{h*0.12}" r="{h*0.26}" fill="{PANEL}" opacity="0.9"/>'
            f'<circle cx="{w*0.08}" cy="{h*0.92}" r="{h*0.2}" fill="{PANEL}" opacity="0.8"/>')

def topbar(w):
    return f'<rect x="0" y="0" width="{w}" height="8" fill="url(#bar)"/>'

def logo(x, y, mark=58, gap=16, wordsize=38, color=INK):
    r = round(mark*0.26)
    return "".join([
        f'<rect x="{x}" y="{y}" width="{mark}" height="{mark}" rx="{r}" fill="url(#bar)"/>',
